name: Cosmic Magic
description:
Bend gravity and drop celestial stone. Physical impacts and craters; fire burn; holy Starfire; void-cold wells. Dust and pin enemies, slam them, build Cosmic Charge, socket Unleash Charge.

Train at a Celestial Collegium or by using abilities.

Every level from 11 onward grants +1 statistic.

Level 30 grants Cosmic Magic Mastery (+10% all attributes; stacks with other combat-branch masteries).
